name: Metal City Fab
old_description: Need something outside of the scope of what we normally do or something that nobody else has been able to offer a solution to? Bring it on! We strive to enhance our skills and challenge our team. We’ve worked with general contractors, architects, interior designers, and private clients on a wide variety of unique and difficult products, providing solutions that impress every time. Check out the gallery below for a few examples of some unique custom fabrications that we’ve produced outside of our typical realm.
about:
Metal City Fab operates from a fabrication facility in Warren, Michigan. The business traces its roots to March 1992 when Len DiGrande, Marc Rudorf, and Gary Oliver founded American Fence & Supply Co. after the owner of King Fence passed away. In 2020, the custom fabrication division was spun out as Metal City Fab, a subsidiary dedicated to commercial and architectural metalwork.

The company provides full-service custom metal fabrication, handling engineering, project management, fabrication, finishing, and field installation under one roof. Its capabilities span railings, structures, gates, stairs, signage, artwork, and industrial fabrications, with in-house laser and water-jet cutting, welding, and PE-stamped structural calculations. The shop has completed over 1,000 projects, maintains a portfolio of 95 documented installations, and offers four proprietary product lines: the ACR4500 railing system, AmeriLouver screening system, MCF Balcony bolt-on balcony, and TeamBox modular dugout system.

Metal City Fab serves general contractors, architects, developers, and construction management firms across commercial, multifamily, hospitality, healthcare, industrial, and municipal sectors. Recent projects include laser-cut galvanized steel fencing for the Warren Civic Center Library, a steel floating stair handrail for City Modern in Detroit, water-jet-cut aluminum balcony railings for Midland Mixed-Use, and an ornamental steel driveway gate for Van Hoosen Jones Cemetery.

The firm emphasizes that it does not outsource critical steps, controlling quality from estimating through installation. Its stated differentiators are proactive communication, value-engineering options, and a set of core values—care, commitment, passion, accountability, and excellence—that guide every project.
